# Testing the Model


5.	Evidence of Correctness
o	Include at least one of the following (more is better):
o	Automated tests (e.g., in a tests/ directory) with a brief description in the README or a TESTING.md file.
o	Comparison to a baseline or known result (e.g., comparison to a standard tool on a small dataset).
o	Clear sanity checks or invariants that your algorithm satisfies (and documentation of how you checked them).
o	You do not need a perfect benchmark, but you must show that you thought carefully about how to evaluate correctness.
